设计意图： Mutation of CROSS-002: preserves the core price-volume coherence mechanism (10-day return multiplied by volume deviation) but replaces the standard z-score (mean/std) with a robust z-score using median and MAD. This reduces the influence of outlier volume observations, aiming to improve IC stability without disrupting the RankICIR strength of the parent.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(multiply(multiply(ts_pct(AdjClose, 10), clip(divide(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20)), (-3), 3)), divide(ts_sum((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) > 0), 10), 10)), 0)
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(multiply(ts_pct(AdjClose, 10), clip(divide(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20)), (-3), 3)), divide(ts_sum((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) > 0), 10), 10))
  3. 3. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_pct(AdjClose, 10), clip(divide(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20)), (-3), 3))
  4. 4. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 10)
  5. 5. clip —— 裁剪到区间[下限,上限]
    clip(divide(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20)), (-3), 3)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)), ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20))
  7. 7. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))
  8. 8. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(Volume, 20)
  9. 9. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))), 20)
  10. 10. abs —— 取绝对值
    abs(subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20)))
  11. 11. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(Volume, ts_median(Volume, 20))
  12. 12. ts_median —— 过去 N 天滚动中位数
    ts_median(Volume, 20)
  13. 13. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_sum((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) > 0), 10), 10)
  14. 14. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum((ts_pct(AdjClose, 1) > 0), 10)
  15. 15. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
ts_mediann 期滚动中位数
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 ret：close.pct_change(10)
  2. 计算 vol_med：volume.滚动窗口(20).median()
  3. 计算 vol_mad：(volume - vol_med).abs().滚动窗口(20).median()
  4. 计算 vol_robust_z：(volume - vol_med) / vol_mad
  5. 计算 vol_robust_z：vol_robust_z.clip(-3, 3)
  6. 计算 daily_ret：close.pct_change()
  7. 计算 persistence：(daily_ret > 0).astype(float).滚动窗口(10).sum() / 10
  8. 计算 factor：ret * vol_robust_z * persistence
  9. 计算 factor：factor
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_volume_persistence_momentum_robust(df): df_copy = df.copy() ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change(10) vol_med = df_copy["str">'volume'].rolling(20).median() vol_mad = (df_copy["str">'volume'] - vol_med).abs().rolling(20).median() vol_robust_z = (df_copy["str">'volume'] - vol_med) / vol_mad.replace(0, np.nan) vol_robust_z = vol_robust_z.clip(-3, 3) daily_ret = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() persistence = (daily_ret > 0).astype(float).rolling(10).sum() / 10 factor = ret * vol_robust_z * persistence factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0) factor.name = "factor_volume_persistence_momentum_robust" "kw">class="kw">return factor
